scenes: Who pays to protect health from heat?
Forty-eight countries put a price on protecting health: about three point three billion dollars a year. | In 2024, international funding committed covered about a third.
That leaves about two-thirds unfunded. | Clinics, warnings and cooler wards wait on that money.
Close the gap before the next heatwave.
